name: stitch-ui-ux-codex
description: Design, review, iterate, and retrieve UI/UX deliverables with a separately configured official Google Stitch Remote MCP.

interface.longDescription: Five GPT-5.6-oriented Codex skills handle prompt-only refinement, evidence-backed design-system extraction, authorized Stitch generation and editing, bounded recoverable multi-screen work, and architecture-preserving React handoff through a separately configured official Google Stitch Remote MCP. The plugin bundles skills only and does not install an MCP server or handle credentials.
defaultPrompt: 用 Stitch 为这个产品生成并评审一套响应式 UI。
分析这个 Stitch 项目并导出 DESIGN.md、截图和 HTML。
把选定的 Stitch 屏幕转换成可维护的 React 组件。
